title: A unified approach to compression-expansion fixed point theorems for operators systems and applications
summary: In this paper, we present some fixed point theorems for operator systems in the line of Krasnosel'skii's theorem in cones. The cone-compression and cone-expansion type conditions are imposed in a component-wise manner. Unlike related results in the literature, the operators are allowed to be defined in the Cartesian product of conical regions delimited by nonconvex sets. Our approach, based on the fixed point index, ensures the existence of a coexistence fixed point--that is, one with nontrivial components.
